newsitem.title: USA: Mid-American Waste to sell most assets.
newsitem.headline: Mid-American Waste to sell most assets.

text.p: Mid-American Waste Systems Inc said Wednesday it had signed a definitive agreement to sell nearly all of its assets to USA Waste Services Inc for $180 million in cash and stock.
Mid-American Waste said that following the agreement, it filed a Chapter 11 petition in U.S. Bankruptcy Court.
The transaction is subject to bankruptcy court aproval. A hearing date has been scheduled for March 7.
After the transaction is complete, USA Waste will service Mid-American Waste's customers.
Mid-American Waste said proceeds of the sale, combined with retained assets, total $227 million, compared to $323 million of outstanding long-term debt as of December 31.
Mid-American Waste said there will be no interruption of waste collection and related services during the Chapter 11 case.
